Dmitri Ivanov: kicking off lumi-7b quant bakeoff on H100 pool, testing AWQ vs GPTQ. Hit reproducible OOMs when hybrid runtime falls back to TensorRT-LLM. Anyone seen mmap/cuda map failures around driver handoff?
Jess Carter: saw similar yesterday with a different model. logs?
Dmitri Ivanov: paste of log block:
```
[2026-03-18 14:22:11] ERROR trtllm_runtime: Failed to allocate device memory: cuMemMap failed: CUresult=0x7
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "trt_driver.py", line 412, in allocate_engine
    base_addr = cuMemCreate(...)
CUDAError: cuMemMap failed: out of memory
```
Maya Singh: that CUresult 0x7 is CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY but the host reports enough free pages. Could be conflicting CUmemMap/allocator state when vLLM runtime is pre-warming cache and TRT tries to exclusive-map. Which driver and Triton versions?
Dmitri Ivanov: CUDA 12.3.1, driver 545.xx, Triton 23.12 (we use trt-llm plugin 2.1). vLLM runtime pinned to container with cuDNN 9.2. Repro steps: run 3x parallel warmup requests with --kv-cache and then send a long prompt that triggers tensor fwd in TRT path.
Ben Cho: possible race with RMEM / cudaMemAddressReserve interplay. Two quick checks: 1) set CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY in the TRT container and 2) disable TRT shared KV mapping: export TRTLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_KV=1 and retest.
Jess Carter: also try bumping ulimit -l or disable MADV_DONTNEED on the mount. We saw glibc madvise causing unmapping under heavy mmap churn.
Dmitri Ivanov: trying CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY now... quick run shows different error:
```
[2026-03-18 14:26:02] WARN trtllm_runtime: fallback to vLLM driver due to cuMemMap failure
[2026-03-18 14:26:05] ERROR vllm: validation mismatch: AWQ int8 outputs diverged by 0.7% -> triggering fallback to float
```
Maya Singh: that divergence indicates quant accuracy regression under fallback combos. For bakeoff, we should isolate quant path: run pure AWQ on vLLM only, then pure GPTQ on TRT-LLM only. Mixed fallback adds nondeterminism.
infra-bot: note added to ticket #INF-1142: 'lumi-7b quant bakeoff: hybrid runtime OOM + fallback accuracy delta'. Assigned to Dmitri.
Ben Cho: if you can't repro with LAZY, also test with CUDA 12.4 or 13.0 edge; drivers changed cuMemMap semantics. We had a fix in 13.0 that avoided the double-map race.
Dmitri Ivanov: thanks — I'll run isolated AWQ and GPTQ pass, try the LAZY + TRTLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_KV toggles, and test driver 13.0. Will post configs/short repro in the ticket. :thumbsup:
vLLM-bot: reminder: please attach tokenized eval set and the eval script (eval/qa_accuracy.py) to the ticket to capture the 0.7% regression.
